content.text:
Needed: A wired link to the router, or a switch with a spare port for ThinkPad home automation server
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "for parts", "wireless", "wifi adapter", "fiber only", "damaged"], "pattern": "ethernet|cat[-\\s]?5e|cat[-\\s]?6|r[-\\s]?j[-\\s]?45|gigabit.{0,20}switch|[58][-\\s]?port.{0,20}switch", "phrasings": [{"text": "ethernet cable", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ethernet+cable", "why": "Finds basic wired patch leads for ThinkPad to router that switch queries miss."}, {"text": "cat6 network cable", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=cat6+network+cable", "why": "Finds higher-spec Cat6 leads sellers list by category not just ethernet."}, {"text": "gigabit ethernet switch", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=gigabit+ethernet+switch", "why": "Finds switches adding a spare wired port when router ports are full."}, {"text": "5 port network switch", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=5+port+network+switch", "why": "Finds small desktop switches sized for home server setup listed by port count."}, {"text": "lan patch lead rj45", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=lan+patch+lead+rj45", "why": "Finds UK-worded LAN RJ45 listings that US ethernet wording misses."}]}
